## Walkthrough

This PR upgrades the cluster-inventory-api dependency to v0.1.2, switches MultiKueue credentials handling to the new `access` API, adds the YAML v3 vendor package, and updates e2e tests to use pre-built secretreader plugin images mounted via Kubernetes image volumes instead of copying plugin binaries via init containers.

## Changes

**ClusterProfile Official Plugin Image Integration**

| Layer / File(s) | Summary |
|---|---|
| **Dependency version bumps** <br> `go.mod`, `hack/tools/go.mod`, `vendor/modules.txt` | Updated `sigs.k8s.io/cluster-inventory-api` to v0.1.2, added `gopkg.in/yaml.v3` as an indirect dependency, and bumped patch versions for `go-openapi` modules and `golang.org/x/time`. |
| **YAML v3 vendored package** <br> `vendor/gopkg.in/yaml.v3/*` | Added complete YAML v3 implementation including encoder, decoder, parser, emitter, type resolver, key sorter, and public marshaling/unmarshaling API with Node-based intermediate representation. |
| **go-openapi package metadata updates** <br> `vendor/github.com/go-openapi/{jsonpointer,jsonreference,swag}/*` | Updated linter configs, documentation, contributor statistics, and security/announcement sections across go-openapi module vendors. |
| **Cluster-Inventory-API v0.1.2 schema and access API** <br> `vendor/sigs.k8s.io/cluster-inventory-api/apis/v1alpha1/*`, `vendor/sigs.k8s.io/cluster-inventory-api/pkg/access/config.go`, `vendor/sigs.k8s.io/cluster-inventory-api/pkg/credentials/config.go` | Added `PlacementDecision` API types with label constants, updated `ClusterProfile` CRD kubebuilder markers for list-type metadata, introduced `pkg/access` API for building Kubernetes client configs from ClusterProfile with extension data policies, and removed deprecated `pkg/credentials` implementation. |
| **MultiKueue controller migration from credentials to access API** <br> `pkg/controller/admissionchecks/multikueue/controllers.go`, `pkg/controller/admissionchecks/multikueue/multikueuecluster.go` | Switched controller initialization to construct cluster-profile credentials via `access.New()` and `access.Config` instead of the deprecated `credentials.New()` and `credentials.Provider`. |
| **E2E infrastructure and plugin image loading** <br> `hack/testing/e2e-common.sh`, `test/util/e2e.go` | Added `CLUSTERPROFILE_OFFICIAL_PLUGIN_IMAGE` environment variable export, image pull step during dependency preparation, image load step for kind clusters, and utility function `GetClusterProfileOfficialPluginImage()`. |
| **E2E test conversion to image volumes for plugin loading** <br> `test/e2e/multikueue/sequential/e2e_test.go` | Updated ClusterProfile plugin test to conditionally use official plugin image via Kubernetes image volumes for v1.35+ clusters, falling back to init-container binary copy for earlier versions. |

🎯 4 (Complex) | ⏱️ ~75 minutes

> 🐰 *A PR so refined, dependencies aligned,*  
> *YAML v3's here, old creds redesigned,*  
> *Image volumes now serve the plugin with grace,*  
> *No more init copies to clutter the place!*

  _⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🟠 Major_ | _⚡ Quick win_
  
  **Gate legacy plugin image pull/load by Kubernetes version support.**
  
  The script still always loads `CLUSTERPROFILE_PLUGIN_IMAGE`, but this PR introduces official image-volume usage and only pulls the official image in the new path. This keeps the legacy/private image as a hard dependency and can break `kind load` on runs where only the official image is available.
  
    
  
  <details>
  <summary>Proposed fix</summary>
  
  ```diff
  +function e2e_supports_image_volume {
  +    # true for k8s >= 1.35.0
  +    [[ "$(printf '%s\n' "1.35.0" "${KIND_VERSION#v}" | sort -V | head -n1)" == "1.35.0" ]]
  +}
  +
   function prepare_docker_images {
  @@
  -    if [[ -n ${CLUSTERPROFILE_VERSION:-} ]]; then
  -        e2e_docker_pull_if_needed "${CLUSTERPROFILE_OFFICIAL_PLUGIN_IMAGE}"
  -    fi
  +    if [[ -n ${CLUSTERPROFILE_VERSION:-} ]]; then
  +        if e2e_supports_image_volume; then
  +            e2e_docker_pull_if_needed "${CLUSTERPROFILE_OFFICIAL_PLUGIN_IMAGE}"
  +        else
  +            e2e_docker_pull_if_needed "${CLUSTERPROFILE_PLUGIN_IMAGE}"
  +        fi
  +    fi
   }
  @@
       if [[ -n "${CLUSTERPROFILE_VERSION:-}" ]]; then
  -        cluster_kind_load_image "$cluster" "${CLUSTERPROFILE_PLUGIN_IMAGE}"
  -        cluster_kind_load_image "$cluster" "${CLUSTERPROFILE_OFFICIAL_PLUGIN_IMAGE}"
  +        if e2e_supports_image_volume; then
  +            cluster_kind_load_image "$cluster" "${CLUSTERPROFILE_OFFICIAL_PLUGIN_IMAGE}"
  +        else
  +            cluster_kind_load_image "$cluster" "${CLUSTERPROFILE_PLUGIN_IMAGE}"
  +        fi
       fi
   }
  ```
  </details>
